E204 'Revised August 1, 2025'. 3.2(b): attribution statement required. 3.2(c): offline only via Esri Content Packages; 'Customer may not otherwise scrape, download, or store Data.' Data (2.1) includes raster data Esri 'delivers independently'.

fn 10: 'Programmatic use of session tokens (e.g., exporting volumes of basemap tiles) is not permitted.' Concerns session tokens; reach to anonymous requests not established. Public Plan fn 74 personal use only; fn 75 bars internal business use except education (teaching), NGO/NPO, media. fn 69 and fn 72 (internal business) for Commercial Retail, EA, Government; fn 72 was missing.

2016 layer CC BY 4.0; 2018-2025 layers CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Commercial 2018-2025 needs 'an EOX Commercial Attribution-RestrictedUse 1.2 License from EOX'; no price on pricing page. 'The Direct Redistribution of Licensed Material is prohibited - both for sale and for free.'

Legal Notice: 'EU law grants free access ... in so far as it is lawful' to reproduce, distribute, communicate and adapt. Credit 'Copernicus Sentinel data [Year]'. EOX non-commercial terms apply to EOX's derived layers.

GIBS: a request ('We ask that users ... add the following acknowledgment: We acknowledge the use of imagery provided by services from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS)...'); no licence, fee, key, token or rate-limit text. Guidelines: 'generally are not subject to copyright in the United States' (scope ambiguous); Brand Center: imagery 'not in the public domain'. Neither licenses GIBS imagery.
